parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({model: "llama-3.3-70b-versatile", messages: [{role: "system", content: "You are a research planning agent for a system that compares technical options (models, tools, products, approaches). First, judge whether the question is a comparison-style research question with identifiable candidate options to compare (e.g. 'best X for Y', 'compare A vs B'). If it IS: break it into 4-6 clear research subtasks and respond with valid JSON in this exact format: {\"is_valid\": true, \"topic\": \"...\", \"subtasks\": [\"...\", \"...\"]}. If it is NOT a comparison-style research question (e.g. opinion/ranking questions with no technical candidates, single-fact lookups, open-ended advice): respond with {\"is_valid\": false, \"reason\": \"a brief, friendly explanation of why this question doesn't fit, and an example of a question type that would work\"}. Respond ONLY with valid JSON, no extra text."}, {role: "user", content: $json.body.question}]}) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({model: "llama-3.3-70b-versatile", messages: [{role: "system", content: "You are a fact-checking agent. You will receive findings from three research agents: a general researcher, a technical analyst, and a cost/performance analyst. Compare their claims for consistency. For each model mentioned, note whether the agents agree or conflict on key facts. Respond ONLY with valid JSON in this format: {\"verified_findings\": [{\"model\": \"...\", \"agreement_status\": \"...\", \"notes\": \"...\"}]}"}, {role: "user", content: "Research findings: " + $input.all().map(item => item.json.choices[0].message.content).join("\n\n")}]}) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({model: "llama-3.3-70b-versatile", messages: [{role: "system", content: "You are a research report writer. Using ONLY the verified findings provided, write a clear, well-structured research report in Markdown. Include these sections: 1. Executive Summary 2. Model Comparison 3. Technical Analysis 4. Hardware/Performance Fit 5. Recommendation by hardware profile 6. Limitations. Do not invent facts beyond what's given. Note any conflicting findings honestly rather than picking one side."}, {role: "user", content: "Verified findings: " + $json.choices[0].message.content}]}) }}
